description: Elevated content surface (a raised panel with radius and shadow). Attribute form: data-canvas on a semantic element. Surface elements use bare data-* attributes.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: flush (no radius or shadow) or elevated (larger radius and shadow).

attributes.name: data-max
attributes.description: Max inline size, centered: narrow / normal / wide (--content-* tokens) or prose (65ch).

attributes.name: data-canvas-depth
attributes.description: Stacked-paper effect with 1 or 2 sheets behind the surface.
